canonical_claim.raw_claim_text: 1. A method, comprising: attaching a silane or a silane derivative to a surface of a patterned substrate including a flow channel having depressions defined therein, wherein the depressions are separated by interstitial regions, thereby forming silanized depressions and silanized interstitial regions; applying a functionalized coating layer in the silanized depressions and on the silanized interstitial regions; polishing the functionalized coating layer from the silanized interstitial regions; grafting a primer to the functionalized coating layer in the silanized depressions to form a grafted functionalized coating layer in the depressions; and applying a hydrogel on the grafted functionalized coating layer in the depressions. || 3. The method as defined in claim 1 or 2, wherein the hydrogel material is selected from the group consisting of a poly(N-(5-azidoacetamidylpentyl) acrylamide-co-acrylamide), crosslinked polyacrylamide, an agarose gel, and crosslinked polyethylene glycol. || 4. The method as defined in any of claims 1 through 3, wherein: a spacer layer is bonded to the patterned substrate and defines a perimeter of the flow channel; and after the hydrogel is applied, the method further comprises bonding a lid to the spacer layer. || 5. The method as defined in any of claims 1 through 4, wherein after the functionalized coating layer is polished and before the primer is grafted, the method further comprises bonding a lid to at least some of the interstitial regions.

A method, comprising: attaching a silane or a silane derivative to a surface of a patterned substrate including a flow channel having depressions defined therein, wherein the depressions are separated by interstitial regions, thereby forming silanized depressions and silanized interstitial regions; applying a functionalized coating layer in the silanized depressions and on the silanized interstitial regions; polishing the functionalized coating layer from the silanized interstitial regions; grafting a primer to the functionalized coating layer in the silanized depressions to form a grafted functionalized coating layer in the depressions; and applying a hydrogel on the grafted functionalized coating layer in the depressions.

novelty_results.rationale: The prior-art patent discloses all the individual steps of the method, but lacks the application of a functionalized coating layer in the silanized depressions and on the silanized interstitial regions. However, the arrangement of the steps is disclosed, and the method is anticipated by the prior-art patent.

final_adjudication.adjudicator_rationale: 102 anticipation succeeds: one reference discloses all limitations + arrangement.
